 About Lucid   

 At Lucid, we are creating an electric future without compromise. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. We build world-class vehicles by pushing performance, efficiency, and design beyond industry limits, setting new standards with vehicles like Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity.

 The Role   

 We are seeking a Sr. SW Quality Technical Validation & Data Systems Engineer focused on software issue evaluation, hands-on log and data analysis, signal monitoring, bench-based validation, and targeted product validation support. This role collects and analyzes logs, cloud data, PCAP traces, CAN data, diagnostics, vehicle signals, and validation results to identify issue patterns, support root cause analysis, and provide actionable findings to Software Development and Validation teams.   

Sr. Software Quality Investigation & Validation Engineer   

 Mission   

 Improve software quality through data-driven issue investigation, technical validation, supplier software quality management, software launch readiness, factory software quality support, and cross-functional engineering collaboration.   

The Role   

Investigate software issues using logs, cloud telemetry, PCAP, CAN, diagnostics, DTCs, and vehicle signal data to identify failure patterns, timing relationships, and root-cause candidates.   

Perform targeted product validation, regression testing, release validation, and fix verification to confirm software quality and customer-facing behavior.   

Analyze vehicle, fleet, and development data to identify emerging software quality risks, recurring defects, and validation gaps.   

Develop and maintain signal-monitoring dashboards, quality metrics, and visualization tools using Grafana and related analytics platforms.   

Collaborate with Software Development, Validation, Diagnostics, Cloud, Automation, and Quality teams to accelerate issue resolution and improve software quality.   

Support Software Safe Launch activities, factory software deployments, ECU flashing validation, OTA release readiness, and production software quality.   

Investigate and triage software issues identified through manufacturing operations, factory diagnostics, launch-quality activities, service feedback, and early field observations.   

Support supplier software quality management activities including issue tracking, root-cause review, corrective-action validation, software readiness assessments, and release quality improvement.   

Partner with internal engineering teams and software suppliers to investigate field and factory issues, validate corrective actions, and drive software quality improvements.   

Provide technical evidence, validation findings, quality status, and investigation summaries to support software quality gate reviews, milestone assessments, and release decisions.   

Drive improvements in logging, telemetry, diagnostics, monitoring capability, issue detection, and software quality processes.   

What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)   

Increased issue reproduction rate and reduced time-to-root-cause for critical software issues.   

Signal-monitoring capability proactively identifies recurring software defects before significant field impact.   

Successful support of Software Safe Launch activities with rapid identification and containment of software-related production issues.   

Improved software deployment quality through validation of ECU flashing and OTA release processes.   

Improved supplier software quality through timely issue resolution, validated corrective actions, and reduced recurring defects.   

Reduced escaped defects and improved software stability across production releases.   

Qualifications   

 Collaboration & Execution   

Strong collaboration skills across Software Development, Validation, Manufacturing Engineering, Diagnostics, Cloud, Automation, Service Engineering, Supplier Engineering, and Quality organizations.   

Ability to communicate complex technical findings through concise, data-driven summaries, dashboards, signal timelines, and actionable recommendations.   

Strong ownership mindset with a focus on software quality, launch readiness, validation efficiency, investigation rigor, and cross-functional execution.   

Technical Qualifications   

7+ years of experience in automotive software validation, embedded software testing, diagnostics, software quality engineering, system integration, vehicle launch support, or related technical disciplines.   

Hands-on experience with software validation, regression testing, release acceptance testing, and customer-facing vehicle software features.   

Experience collecting and analyzing vehicle logs, PCAP, CAN data, diagnostics, DTCs, cloud telemetry, and large-scale signal datasets.   

Strong understanding of vehicle networks, ECU communication, CAN, Ethernet, diagnostics, software deployment, and software validation processes.   

Experience supporting ECU software flashing, OTA updates, release readiness reviews, production software quality activities, or launch support.   

Experience working with software suppliers to manage defect investigations, review root-cause analyses, validate corrective actions, and support software release readiness.   

Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills with the ability to connect customer symptoms, vehicle behavior, signal evidence, and software implementation details.   

Familiarity with automotive software quality processes, defect management, launch-quality activities, and milestone-based development programs.   

Proficiency with Python, SQL, CAN DBC databases, Grafana, InfluxDB, Prometheus, or similar data analysis and monitoring tools.   

Education   

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related technical discipline preferred.   

Equivalent hands-on experience in automotive software validation, diagnostics, embedded systems, software quality, technical investigations, supplier quality, or manufacturing quality support will also be considered.

 This position requires a seasoned professional with deep  expertise  in  higher levels of driving automation , a strong understanding of the transition from L2+ assisted driving to conditionally and highly automated (L3/L4) driving, and a proven  track record  of bringing innovative ADAS/AD software features into production. Our ideal candidate  exhibits  a can-do attitude, approaches their work with vigor and determination, and thrives in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.   

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES   

Conceptualize, prototype, and launch cutting-edge L2++/L3/L4 driving features, including but not limited to:    

Hands-off highway driving with driver monitoring system (DMS) supervision   

Automated lane changes and highway merge/exit maneuvers   

Urban automated driving (intersections, traffic signals, roundabouts)   

Conditional automation (L3) with fallback-ready transition of control (ToC) strategies   

Geo-fenced L4 highway pilot with minimal driver intervention   

Advanced longitudinal and lateral control (steering, braking, acceleration) on ODD-defined roads   

Own the end-to-end feature lifecycle from concept through production launch ensuring timely delivery of fully validated high-quality customer features    

Create and manage feature roadmaps for multiple vehicle program lines, securing buy-in from stakeholders including marketing, homologation, safety, and executive leadership    

Serve as the voice of the customer, representing L2++/L3/L4 features in all internal and external communications    

Develop comprehensive feature definitions, including use cases, operational design domains (ODD), functional requirements, and target performance KPIs    

Collaborate closely with the Functional Safety team to facilitate HARA, Safety Goal development, and SOTIF (Safety of the Intended Functionality) analysis specific to higher automation levels    

Drive feature specifications using creative ideas and lead usability studies with UX/UI design teams, focusing on seamless handoff experiences between automated and manual driving    

Partner with Tier 1 suppliers and internal teams (perception, planning, controls, mapping) to implement innovative L2++/L3/L4 solutions    

Lead competitive benchmarking to stay current with industry trends, emerging regulations, and competitor L3/L4 offerings    

Work cross-functionally with systems engineering, software, validation, and homologation teams to ensure seamless and robust feature development and delivery    

Support V&V strategy development for higher automation features, including scenario-based testing, simulation, and real-world validation approaches  

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:   

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field    

3–5 years of hands-on experience in ADAS/AD feature development, with a focus on L2+ and above driving automation features    

Proven track record of bringing ADAS/AD driving features into production (e.g., highway assist, traffic jam pilot, automated lane change, hands-off driving)    

Strong expertise in use case development, ODD definition, and requirements engineering for L2++/L3/L4 features    

Solid understanding of SAE J3016 automation levels and the functional/architectural differences between L2+, L3, and L4 systems    

Experience with automotive supplier interaction, specification development, project/release management, and change management    

Strong understanding of regulations and standards relevant to higher automation:    

Regulations: FMVSS, GSR, ECE R79, ECE R157, DCAS-R171   

Standards: ISO 26262, ISO/PAS 21448 (SOTIF), ASPICE, ISO 34502/34503   

Proficiency with  requirements management tools  (JAMA, DOORS, etc.)    

Proficiency with  agile development tools  such as JIRA    

Excellent communication skills and ability to present complex automation concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences   

Preferred Qualifications:   

Master’s degree in systems engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field   

Previous experience as a Feature Owner or Product Owner for L2+/L3/L4 driving functions at an OEM or Tier 1 supplier   

Experience with driver monitoring systems (DMS) and their integration with hands-off/eyes-off driving modes   

Familiarity with scenario-based testing frameworks, simulation tools (e.g., dSPACE, CarMaker, CARLA), and SiL/HiL validation for AD features   

Knowledge of perception sensor suites (camera, radar, LiDAR, ultrasonics) and sensor fusion architectures relevant to L3/L4   

Understanding of motion planning, path planning, and decision-making algorithms at a conceptual level   

Experience with Euro NCAP testing and scoring methodologies, particularly for assisted driving grading schemes   

Knowledge of in-vehicle communication protocols (CAN, LIN, Automotive Ethernet)   

Experience with feature-level project management and ADAS software development processes   

Familiarity with OTA (Over-the-Air) update strategies for iterative feature deployment
